verdict.rationale: GA4's own documented outbound paths are first-party Google only. The Admin API exposes googleAdsLinks and bigQueryLinks resources, and GA4 exports raw events to BigQuery daily and continuously through the day. That gives limited routing of event data to an ad platform and a warehouse, not general streaming to third-party destinations. Onward export from BigQuery to external storage is a BigQuery feature, not GA4's, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: third-party event forwarding/destinations (CRM, non-Google ad platforms), registrable outbound webhooks, real-time per-event streaming to arbitrary endpoints, independent corroboration.
